question: Rani Velu Nachiyar, celebrated for her bravery and leadership, was born in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1730.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Rani Velu Nachiyar, the first Indian queen to actively resist the British East India Company, was born in 1730 in Ramanathapuram, Tamil Nadu.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Born in 1730, she was the daughter of the ruler of the Ramnad kingdom and well educated in languages and martial skills.**
 
• Married to the ruler of Sivagangai kingdom, she formed alliances with Hyder Ali and Gopala Nayaker to resist the British.
 
• She formed an army including women soldiers and successfully reclaimed the Sivagangai kingdom after defeating British forces.
 
• Known as **Veeramangai** in Tamil history, she is remembered for bravery, leadership, and anti-colonial resistance; her birth anniversary is observed on 3 January.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Rani Velu Nachiyar__

 __
 
• First Indian queen to wage armed resistance against the British East India Company, decades before the 1857 Revolt.
 
• Trained in martial arts, horse riding, and weaponry from a young age.
 
• Proficient in multiple languages and strategically skilled in forming alliances.
 
 
 
• Sivagangai Kingdom__
 __
 
• Rani Velu Nachiyar married the ruler of Sivagangai and later reclaimed the kingdom after British occupation.
 
• Her military leadership included organizing women soldiers in her army.
 
 
 
• Legacy__
 
 
• Remembered as a symbol of women’s leadership, courage, and anti-colonial resistance.
 
• The title **Veeramangai** honors her valor in Tamil history and cultural memory.
